household.root_description: a practical rural village adult woman in her thirties, weathered friendly face, dark brown hair tied back in a low knot, muted moss-green work tunic with rolled sleeves, ochre linen apron tied over it at the front, plain earth-brown trousers, simple worn brown shoes, a small woven basket held at her left hip, right hand relaxed at her side, no weapon, no emblem, no headwear, realistic adult proportions
household.root_back: From behind the apron shows only as its tie at the waist; the back of the tunic is plain moss green.

watch.root_description: an anonymous rural village watchman, sturdy adult man, plain weathered face, practical soft brown cloth cap, sturdy knee-length muted olive-green padded coat with a plain leather belt, earth-brown trousers, brown wrapped boots, holding a plain straight wooden spear upright in his right hand with the butt on the ground beside his foot, left hand relaxed, no insignia, no armour, no helmet, realistic adult proportions
watch.root_back: From behind the coat back is plain olive green; the spear stays upright at his right side.

mira.root_description: Elder Mira, an elderly woman in her seventies, weathered brown skin and a lined stern face, white hair in a tight bun, a large green shawl with ochre-yellow stripes wrapped over her shoulders, long dark brown tunic, simple dark trousers and flat brown shoes, a gentle stoop, her right hand resting on top of a plain wooden walking stick planted beside her right foot, left hand inside the shawl, realistic elderly proportions
mira.root_back: From behind the striped green shawl covers her back and the white bun shows at the top.

gao.root_description: Gao, a round olive-skinned merchant in his fifties, broad waist and sturdy short legs, short grey-flecked dark beard, brown soft flat cap, green tunic with rolled sleeves under a long cream apron, a string of dried red peppers hanging at his right shoulder and two brown leather waterskins at his left hip, holding a small wooden abacus against his chest with his left arm, charcoal trousers, brown cloth shoes, friendly watchful expression
gao.root_back: From behind the back of the green tunic is plain green with only a thin dark brown apron tie at the waist; no white straps, no cross, no lettering on the back.

pella.root_description: Pella, a small nine-year-old girl with natural child proportions, about five heads tall and much shorter than an adult, messy dark brown pigtails, light-brown skin, cream loose tunic with a patched green sash, calf-length brown trousers, simple flat shoes, hugging a large green cabbage against her chest with both arms; plain still figure, no effects
pella.root_back: From behind both pigtails show and the cabbage is mostly hidden in front of her.

dorin.root_description: Dorin, a lanky tall thin young man in his late twenties, long face, large ears, short tousled brown hair, wispy moustache, oversized long green provincial guard coat with a brass clasp, dark trousers, brown boots, no helmet, holding a plain straight wooden spear vertically at his right side, spear tip above his head; the spear is one straight shaft with a single small plain leaf-shaped iron point, no fork, no prongs, no hooks
dorin.root_back: From behind the long green coat back is plain; the spear stays upright at his right side.

thug.root_description: a lean young bandit man, tan skin, shaggy dark brown hair under a rust-red bandana with short trailing ties, sleeveless worn dark brown vest open at the chest, a rope belt, ragged grey-brown knee-length trousers with torn hems, cloth-wrapped shins and forearms, simple sandals, a short knobbed wooden club held low in his right hand
thug.root_back: From behind the bandana knot and its ties show at the back of the head; the vest back is plain dark brown.

slinger.root_description: a lean young bandit, tan skin, a dark grey-brown cloth hood worn up, sleeveless dark grey-brown wrap tunic to mid-thigh with a rust-red cloth belt, ragged grey-brown trousers, cloth-wrapped shins and forearms, simple sandals, a leather sling dangling from his right hand
slinger.root_back: From behind the hood covers the back of the head; the tunic back is plain grey-brown.

bruiser.root_description: a big heavyset bandit man, very broad shoulders and thick arms, tan skin, shaved head with a rust-red headband, short dark beard, open sleeveless dark brown leather vest over a bare chest, cloth-wrapped forearms, baggy dark grey-brown trousers, heavy brown boots, a heavy knobbed wooden club held low in his right hand
bruiser.root_back: From behind the vest back is plain dark brown and the headband knot shows at the back of the head; he holds only one club, in his right hand; seen from behind and to the left the club is hidden in front of his body and his left hand is empty.
